rationale: The Latin anchors *excitare* and *accendere* ("to kindle/inflame") point to arousing or eliciting feelings/emotions, which aligns best with excite.v.01 ("arouse or elicit a feeling"). The figurative sense of "whetting" (a-hwettan) as stirring up passion or zeal fits this synset more precisely than the physical stimulant or sexual arousal senses.
